title: Iran-Contra: Tower Commission & Walsh Report
summary: The Reagan administration secretly sold arms to Iran and diverted proceeds to Nicaragua's Contras despite the Boland Amendment ban. Tower Commission (Feb 1987): Reagan's 'lax managerial style.' Walsh final report (Aug 1993): 14 officials charged, 11 convictions/guilty pleas; arms sales 'contravened U.S. Government policy'; systematic document destruction documented. George H.W. Bush's Dec 24, 1992 pardons ended the probe.
